name: GT-22
description: GT-22 was a GT astromech droid that was a member of the Galactic Republic Pathfinder team Outer Rim Expedition Eight-Zero-Seven. In 382 BBY, the team gave the Jedi Masters Porter Engle and Barash Silvain passage to the world Gansevor.
